title: GraphAPI 1.0 document
description: A GraphAPI 1.0 document describes a GraphQL schema as a JSON value designed to be compared and processed by tools.

graphapi.description: The specification version. MUST be the string "1.0" (in YAML it MUST be quoted).

description.description: The description of the schema definition.

directives.description: Directive usages on the schema definition (location SCHEMA), including those added with extend schema @d.

queryTypeName.description: Name of the query root type. Present if and only if the schema has a query root type, whatever its name.

mutationTypeName.description: Name of the mutation root type. Present if and only if the schema has a mutation root type.

subscriptionTypeName.description: Name of the subscription root type. Present if and only if the schema has a subscription root type.

queries.description: The fields of the query root type, keyed by field name. Present if and only if the schema has a query root type.

mutations.description: The fields of the mutation root type, keyed by field name. Present if and only if the schema has a mutation root type.

subscriptions.description: The fields of the subscription root type, keyed by field name. Present if and only if the schema has a subscription root type.

name.title: Name
name.description: A GraphQL name (the key of every entry MUST be the GraphQL name of the type or directive).

description.title: Description
description.description: The description of an element; omitted when there is no description or an empty description.

components.title: Components Object
components.description: Holds the named types and directive definitions of the schema, grouped by kind; every definition has the type of its section. The Components Object itself MUST be omitted when all its sections are.

scalars.description: Custom scalar types. Built-in scalars MUST NOT appear.

objects.description: Object types other than the root operation types.

directives.description: Directive definitions: every custom definition, and the built-in definitions that are used or overridden.

implementerReference.title: Implementer Reference Object
implementerReference.description: An entry of implementedBy: an object or interface component whose interfaces contains this interface.

nonNull.title: Non-null
nonNull.description: Present, with the value true, when the position is non-null, where the SDL writes !. Absent means nullable. Producers MUST NOT write nonNull: false.

usageType.title: Usage type
usageType.description: The type of a Type Usage: a built-in scalar (Int, Float, String, Boolean, ID), which is not stored in components, or list.

outputTypeUsage.title: Output Type Usage
outputTypeUsage.description: A reference to a type at an output position (operation or field result, output list item), written flat next to the properties of the usage site: exactly one of $ref (a custom scalar, object, interface, union or enum) and type (a built-in scalar, or list with items), plus nonNull: true when non-null.

items.description: The type usage of the list item, with its own nonNull. Present if and only if type is list.

outputListItem.title: Output list item
outputListItem.description: The items of a list in an output position: an Output Type Usage without any other property.

inputTypeUsage.title: Input Type Usage
inputTypeUsage.description: A reference to a type at an input position (argument, input field, directive argument, input list item), written flat next to the properties of the usage site: exactly one of $ref (a custom scalar, enum or input object) and type (a built-in scalar, or list with items), plus nonNull: true when non-null.

items.description: The type usage of the list item, with its own nonNull. Present if and only if type is list.

inputListItem.title: Input list item
inputListItem.description: The items of a list in an input position: an Input Type Usage without any other property.

deprecation.title: Deprecation Object
deprecation.description: The resolved deprecation reason: the given reason, or "No longer supported" when none was given.

directiveUsage.title: Directive Usage Object
directiveUsage.description: One application of a directive to an element: { $ref: '#/components/directives/<name>', meta? }.

meta.description: The arguments given in the usage, keyed by argument name, as JSON values. Omitted when the usage has no arguments.

directives.title: Directive usages
directives.description: Elements list their usages in a directives array in source order; a repeatable directive applied several times produces one entry per usage.

deprecatable.title: Element Object
deprecatable.description: An element that is deprecated MUST carry both the Deprecation Object and, as the first entry of its directives, the usage { $ref: '#/components/directives/deprecated', meta: { reason } }.

operation.title: Operation Object
operation.description: A field of a root operation type (in queries, mutations, subscriptions) or of an object or interface type (in methods): an Element Object with args and the result type written flat as an Output Type Usage.

args.description: The field arguments, keyed by name, in declaration order. Omitted when the field has none.

argument.title: Argument Object
argument.description: An argument of a field or directive definition, or an input object field: an Element Object with its type written flat as an Input Type Usage and an optional default.

default.description: The default value as a JSON value. Present when, and only when, a default is declared; a declared null default is written as default: null.

enumValue.title: Enum Value Object
enumValue.description: An Enum Value Object is an Element Object (location ENUM_VALUE for its directives). A value without description, deprecation and directives is the empty object {}.

scalar.title: Scalar Object
scalar.description: A Definition Object for a custom scalar: type "scalar" and an optional specifiedByURL.

type.description: The kind of the definition: "scalar", as for every definition in components.scalars.

directives.description: Directive usages on the type (location SCALAR, OBJECT, INTERFACE, UNION, ENUM or INPUT_OBJECT), including those added with extend … @d.

specifiedByURL.description: The url of the scalar's @specifiedBy directive.

object.title: Object Type Object
object.description: A Definition Object for an object type other than a root operation type: type "object", interfaces and methods.

type.description: The kind of the definition: "object", as for every definition in components.objects.

directives.description: Directive usages on the type (location SCALAR, OBJECT, INTERFACE, UNION, ENUM or INPUT_OBJECT), including those added with extend … @d.

interfaces.description: The interfaces this type implements, in declaration order. Omitted when it implements none.

methods.description: The fields, keyed by name, in declaration order (fields added by extend follow).

interface.title: Interface Object
interface.description: A Definition Object for an interface type: type "interface", interfaces, implementedBy and methods.

type.description: The kind of the definition: "interface", as for every definition in components.interfaces.

directives.description: Directive usages on the type (location SCALAR, OBJECT, INTERFACE, UNION, ENUM or INPUT_OBJECT), including those added with extend … @d.

interfaces.description: The interfaces this type implements, in declaration order. Omitted when it implements none.

implementedBy.description: Interfaces only: every object and interface component whose interfaces contains this interface, sorted by type name. Root operation types are not listed. Omitted when there is none.

methods.description: The fields, keyed by name, in declaration order (fields added by extend follow).

union.title: Union Object
union.description: A Definition Object for a union type: type "union" and oneOf.

type.description: The kind of the definition: "union", as for every definition in components.unions.

directives.description: Directive usages on the type (location SCALAR, OBJECT, INTERFACE, UNION, ENUM or INPUT_OBJECT), including those added with extend … @d.

oneOf.description: The member types (#/components/objects/<Name>), in declaration order.

enum.title: Enum Object
enum.description: A Definition Object for an enum type: type "enum" and values.

type.description: The kind of the definition: "enum", as for every definition in components.enums.

directives.description: Directive usages on the type (location SCALAR, OBJECT, INTERFACE, UNION, ENUM or INPUT_OBJECT), including those added with extend … @d.

values.description: Every value of the enum, keyed by its (case-sensitive) name, in declaration order.

inputObject.title: Input Object Object
inputObject.description: A Definition Object for an input object type: type "input" and properties.

type.description: The kind of the definition: "input", as for every definition in components.inputObjects.

directives.description: Directive usages on the type (location SCALAR, OBJECT, INTERFACE, UNION, ENUM or INPUT_OBJECT), including those added with extend … @d.

properties.description: The input fields, keyed by name, in declaration order.

directiveDefinition.title: Directive Definition Object
directiveDefinition.description: A directive definition stored in components.directives.

locations.description: The directive locations (FIELD_DEFINITION, OBJECT, …), in declaration order.

args.description: The directive arguments. Omitted when the directive has none.

repeatable.description: true for a repeatable directive, false otherwise. Always present.

rootTypes.title: Root Types Object
rootTypes.description: The Root Types Object has the optional fields query, mutation and subscription, each a Root Type Object for the corresponding root operation type.

rootType.title: Root Type Object
rootType.description: Description, directive usages and implemented interfaces of a root operation type. An entry MUST be omitted when the root type has no description, no directive usages and implements no interface.

directives.description: Directive usages on the root type (location OBJECT).

interfaces.description: The interfaces the root type implements (type Query implements Node), in declaration order.
